integrity: Proof is theoretical; 300000-range exact checks are corroborative, not an infinite proof. This report contains no independent audit or claim of priority certification.
scientific_limitations: The result treats integers with at most one distinct squared prime divisor. It gives no classification of the complementary class, nor a full proof of the Ligh-Wall conjecture. Priority risk persists for uncatalogued elementary arguments. Original 1987 source is dated November without day; 2001-09-25 is the earliest fully day-resolved accessible source record, not the first discovery or publication.
title: Rigidity of nonunitary-perfect integers with one repeated prime
